name: Nonparametric Statistical Methods
description: Order statistics, their distributions, and associated statistical properties; Introduction to nonparametric tests; Comparison of parametric and nonparametric tests; Tests for randomness: run test; Goodness of fit tests: chi-square test, one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test; One-sample and paired-sample tests: sign test, Wilcoxon signed-rank test; Rank-order statistics; Two-sample tests: Wald-Wolfowitz run test, Kolmogorov-Smirnov two-sample test, median test, Mann-Whitney 'U' test; Linear rank tests for location and scale problems, k-sample problems; Measures of association; Asymptotic relative efficiency; Bootstrap and Jackknife resampling methods; Nonparametric regression.
